history.text: Patient reports sweetened tea with biscuits at breakfast and canteen rice and dal at lunch
history.source_quote: Breakfast mein chai with two teaspoons sugar aur two biscuits. Lunch office canteen mein rice aur dal hota hai.

history.text: Patient reports dinner around 10:30, usually three rotis
